items.text:
7. ESTABLISH – NO STOPPING, EXCEPT BICYCLES
ESTABLISH – BIKE SHARE STATION
Toland Street, east side, from 12 feet to 48 feet south of Jerrold Avenue (36-foot bike share station)
(Supervisor District 10) (Approvable by the City Traffic Engineer) Laura Stonehill,
[staff email removed — see the order]

Proposal to install a Bay Wheels bike share station in the parking lane on the east side of Toland
Street, south of Jerrold Avenue, adjacent to the SF Market.

Public Comments: Received email in support prior to public hearing. Comment regarding potential
impact to the currently re-routed 23-Monterey if the route returns to Jerrold. Question raised
regarding coordination with the Produce Market. Received comment in opposition due to parking
loss. Suggestion made to place bikeshare stations on sidewalks.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer for implementation.
